summary: Starts workspace session checks while the dashboard downloads and loads secondary screens on demand.
userImpact: The dashboard can fetch project data as soon as the browser verifies the session. Engine and process information continue to load independently.
security: Early reads use the existing session transport and are accepted only for the current browser session.
documentation: Release notes describe the earlier session checks and on-demand screens.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding compatible frontend image.
validation: Browser comparisons cover cold and warm dashboard loads as an owner and a member, including independently delayed engine data.

customerDocumentation.reason: The existing dashboard and sign-in controls are unchanged.
